title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) Operational Guidelines
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
content: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme launched to supplement the financial needs of landholding farmers. Financial Benefit: Under the scheme, an income support of Rs. 6,000 per year is provided in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 each every 4 months (April-July, August-November, December-March) directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of beneficiary farmer families through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Eligibility Criteria: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible. Exclusions: Institutional landholders; farmer families holding constitutional posts; former and present MPs/MLAs/Mayors/Zilla Panchayat Chairpersons; serving or retired government employees; professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs); individuals who paid income tax in last assessment year; and pensioners receiving monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more. Mandatory Requirements: 1. Aadhaar Card, 2. Land ownership papers (Khatauni/ROR), 3. Aadhaar-linked active bank account with NPCI mapping, 4. Mandatory e-KYC (completed via OTP on PM-KISAN portal or biometrics at CSC). Application procedure: Self-registration through Farmer Corner on https://pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centres (CSCs).
